title: Delgado remote-controls a bull with a brain implant

tellings.quote: implanting putting an implant in the head of a bull and basically being able to remote control a bull

plain: In Spain in the 1960s, a scientist named Jose Delgado is said to have put an implant into a bull's head and then steered the animal by remote control, and there is film footage of the experiment. The researcher Greg Malatzi describes it, without citing a source beyond the footage, as "basically being able to remote control a bull." He raises it because, if true, it would show that a brain could be controlled from the outside as far back as the 1960s.
